name: airtable
description: Reads Airtable Web API, SCIM, metadata, comments, webhook payloads, enterprise/admin, HyperDB direct reads, and executes typed record/schema/admin mutations from fixture-tested declarative definitions.

risk.read: external Airtable API reads for base, table, record, comment, webhook, SCIM, collaborator, enterprise, audit, eDiscovery, and change-event metadata
risk.write: typed Airtable API mutations for records, schema, comments, webhooks, SCIM, collaborators, enterprise/admin, HyperDB, and attachment upload; destructive/admin actions require plan, preview, explicit approval, and execute
